reason: I replayed home.command-chart with a MutationObserver watching the page: the progress text (Fetching relevant skills, Evaluating options, the timer) and the whole streamed answer were added to ordinary containers, and no change ever landed in a live region. The one aria-live=polite region in the messages container stays empty and focus stays on the textbox, so a screen reader user hears nothing when the reply arrives. The quoted text is the user echoed prompt, but the same container takes the answer. Not a money movement, and the answer can still be read by browsing, so it stays medium.
